subject: Great meeting at Inference Summit — quick recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@edgeai.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at Inference Summit — quick recap & next steps

Hi Samir —

Really enjoyed our conversation at the Inference Summit last week — thanks for taking the time to walk me through EdgeAI's current inference bottlenecks. Quick recap to make sure I'm capturing your priorities: 

- Primary goal: reduce 95th-percentile latency for real-time reranking calls (current median ~120ms, spiking to 450ms during peak)
- Secondary: reduce per-token inference cost for batch scoring jobs (heavy QPS spikes mid-day)
- Preference: explore a dedicated/private deployment for data isolation and SLAs, but open to a hybrid routing approach for burst traffic

What we proposed on the call:
- 2-week pilot on a dedicated GPU pool configured with prefix caching and dynamic batching to validate latency & cost improvements
- Technical deep dive / architecture review with our solutions engineer (Aditya) to map integration points and SSO/KMS requirements
- A short evaluation checklist (SOC 2 evidence, data flow diagram, expected RPS/latency SLOs) so we can size the pilot correctly

I've attached a short solution overview that covers our Dedicated and Private options and a sample pilot plan (redwood-inference-solution-overview.pdf).

Are you available for a 60-minute technical sync next week? I can do: 
- Wed 6/17 between 10-12 PT
- Thu 6/18 between 1-4 PT

If those don't work, Happy to propose a couple more slots or loop in your engineering lead.

Thanks again — excited to explore how Redwood can help stabilize latency and lower unit costs for EdgeAI.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (650) 555-0143

Attachment: redwood-inference-solution-overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Hi Marissa —

Apologies — things have been a bit chaotic post-conference. Thanks for the follow-up and the clear recap. This is still top of mind for us.

Would love to schedule a technical sync — July 1st or 2nd works on our side. For the sync we'd like to make sure we cover: SOC 2 evidence for Redwood Private, network topology for a VPC deployment, and expected latency improvements for small-sequence reranking (we'll share sample traces ahead of time).

I've cc'd Aditya so we can pick a slot that works for your engineering team. Also, can you confirm if the pilot requires any datasets from our side or if Redwood can run an initial smoke test using synthetic traces?

Thanks,
